mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing skin and blood renewal together showed that the body keeps replacing cells while the person carries on.

leastWorthwhile.text: The bone-cell pairing was confusing: the pictures suggested their related jobs, but not that bone removal had to be connected to the body first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that bone is renewed too, with old material cleared before new material fills the patch.

arbitrary.text: The required order for the bone cells was not clear until the compatibility hint; after that, its purpose made sense.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter connected these processes to a new everyday question. The renewal examples were interesting, though some assembly steps felt predictable.
